name: External Link Warning
author: Bulwark Mail Community
description: Warns before external links open a domain that isn't on the trusted list. Admins can add trusted domains and check links with their own link check service or Google Safe Browsing first.

trustedDomains.label: Trusted domains (organisation-wide)
trustedDomains.description: Comma- or newline-separated list of trusted domains. Applies to every user. Subdomains match automatically (example.com also trusts docs.example.com).

lookup.label: Check links before they open
lookup.description: Off: only the trusted-domain warning. Company service: your own link check gets the full URL. Google Safe Browsing: Google gets only short hash prefixes of the link, never the URL (non-commercial use only). Both: the two side by side.

endpointUrl.label: Link check service URL
endpointUrl.description: Bulwark posts {"url", "host"} here and expects {"verdict": "safe" | "unsafe" | "unknown"}. https only; a plain-http address works only when the server admin lists its origin in PLUGIN_PROXY_PRIVATE_ORIGINS. See the plugin README for the full contract.

endpointToken.label: Link check service token
endpointToken.description: Optional. Sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Leave empty if the service needs none.

safeBrowsingKey.label: Google Safe Browsing API key
safeBrowsingKey.description: An API key of a Google Cloud project with the Safe Browsing API enabled. The Safe Browsing API is for non-commercial use only.

onFailure.label: When a link can't be checked
onFailure.description: Open: users see the domain warning with "Couldn't check this link" and may continue. Closed: the link can't be opened until the check works again.

onUnsafe.label: When a check flags a link
onUnsafe.description: Warn: a strong warning, users may still open it. Block: the link can't be opened.

skipTrusted.label: Don't check trusted domains
skipTrusted.description: Links to trusted domains open without a check.

trustedDomainsCsv.label: Trusted domains
trustedDomainsCsv.description: Comma- or newline-separated list of trusted domains (e.g. example.com, github.com). Subdomains are matched automatically.

rememberLocalChoices.label: Offer “Always trust”
rememberLocalChoices.description: After you continue to an unknown domain, ask whether to always trust it on this device. Only the “Always trust” button remembers the domain.

en.dialog.title: Open external link?
en.trust.title: Trust {host} from now on?
en.trust.message: Links to {host} and its subdomains will open without this warning on this device.
en.text.mismatch: The link text says {text}, but the link goes to {host}.
en.unsafe.title: This link may be dangerous
en.blocked.title: Link blocked
en.closed.title: Link couldn't be checked
en.google.title: Suspected dangerous site
en.google.SOCIAL_ENGINEERING: Google Safe Browsing reports that this site may be a phishing site. It may try to trick you into giving away passwords or other personal information.
en.google.MALWARE: Google Safe Browsing reports that this site may install harmful software on your device.
en.google.UNWANTED_SOFTWARE: Google Safe Browsing reports that this site may offer software that changes your device in ways you may not want.
en.google.POTENTIALLY_HARMFUL_APPLICATION: Google Safe Browsing reports that this site may offer apps that could harm your device.
en.google.imperfect: These warnings aren't always right, and a site without a warning isn't always safe.
en.google.blocked: Your organisation doesn't allow opening links like this.

de.dialog.title: Externen Link öffnen?
de.trust.title: {host} ab jetzt vertrauen?
de.trust.message: Links zu {host} und seinen Subdomains öffnen sich auf diesem Gerät dann ohne diese Warnung.
de.check.failed: Dieser Link konnte nicht geprüft werden.
de.text.mismatch: Der Linktext nennt {text}, der Link führt aber zu {host}.
de.unsafe.title: Dieser Link ist möglicherweise gefährlich
de.blocked.title: Link gesperrt
de.closed.title: Link konnte nicht geprüft werden
de.google.title: Vermutlich gefährliche Website
de.google.SOCIAL_ENGINEERING: Laut Google Safe Browsing ist diese Website möglicherweise eine Phishing-Seite. Sie könnte versuchen, Sie zur Eingabe von Passwörtern oder anderen persönlichen Daten zu verleiten.
de.google.MALWARE: Laut Google Safe Browsing installiert diese Website möglicherweise schädliche Software auf Ihrem Gerät.
de.google.UNWANTED_SOFTWARE: Laut Google Safe Browsing bietet diese Website möglicherweise Software an, die Ihr Gerät auf unerwünschte Weise verändert.
de.google.POTENTIALLY_HARMFUL_APPLICATION: Laut Google Safe Browsing bietet diese Website möglicherweise Apps an, die Ihrem Gerät schaden könnten.
de.google.imperfect: Solche Warnungen sind nicht immer richtig, und eine Website ohne Warnung ist nicht immer sicher.
de.google.blocked: Ihre Organisation erlaubt nicht, solche Links zu öffnen.
